title: Ten Minutes to Twelve  (Diez minutos para las doce)

segments.t: Dentro, en la recepción, a las once y cincuenta, Arthur se endereza su corbata azul limpia mientras Hannah y Tessa miran el reloj, justo cuando el cartero deja un sobre blanco grueso en el mostrador. Escuchemos primero.
How does my tie look today, Hannah? Zero orange juice in sight!
Sharp and spotless, Arthur! Even your glasses are on your nose instead of your forehead.
Progress! Today our courtyard hosts a family reunion. Quiet dignity from everyone!
Says the man peeking through the lace curtain every thirty seconds!
I am checking the weather, Tessa! Who left this thick envelope by the bell?
The mailman just asked me to sign for it. It has a red property office stamp.
From the building landlord's lawyer? Strange, our rent is paid until next summer.
Open it after twelve, boss! Look at the clock: five minutes to noon!
Right you are. Paperwork can wait. Put it beside the book for now.
I placed the blue suitcase right beside Caleb's table under the tree.
And the teapot is hot! Everybody step back from the window!
Listen... the church clock down the street is starting to chime twelve!
Ahora recorramos cada línea de la escena.
How does my tie look today, Hannah? Zero orange juice in sight!
'¿Cómo se ve mi corbata hoy, Hannah? ¡Cero zumo de naranja a la vista!'
Sharp and spotless, Arthur! Even your glasses are on your nose instead of your forehead.
'¡Elegante e impecable, Arthur! Incluso tus gafas están en tu nariz en vez de en tu frente.'
Progress! Today our courtyard hosts a family reunion. Quiet dignity from everyone!
'¡Eso es avanzar! Hoy nuestro patio acoge un reencuentro familiar. ¡Serenidad y dignidad por parte de todos!'
Says the man peeking through the lace curtain every thirty seconds!
'¡Lo dice el hombre que se asoma por la cortina de encaje cada treinta segundos!'
I am checking the weather, Tessa! Who left this thick envelope by the bell?
'¡Estoy mirando el tiempo, Tessa! ¿Quién dejó este sobre grueso junto al timbre?'
The mailman just asked me to sign for it. It has a red property office stamp.
'El cartero acaba de pedirme que firmara para recibirlo. Lleva un sello rojo de la oficina de la propiedad.'
From the building landlord's lawyer? Strange, our rent is paid until next summer.
'¿Del abogado del propietario del edificio? Qué raro, nuestro alquiler está pagado hasta el próximo verano.'
Open it after twelve, boss! Look at the clock: five minutes to noon!
'¡Ábrelo después de las doce, jefe! Mira el reloj: ¡faltan cinco minutos para el mediodía!'
Right you are. Paperwork can wait. Put it beside the book for now.
'Tienes toda la razón. El papeleo puede esperar. Ponlo al lado del libro por ahora.'
I placed the blue suitcase right beside Caleb's table under the tree.
'Coloqué la maleta azul justo al lado de la mesa de Caleb bajo el árbol.'
And the teapot is hot! Everybody step back from the window!
'¡Y la tetera está caliente! ¡Todo el mundo un paso atrás de la ventana!'
Listen... the church clock down the street is starting to chime twelve!
'Escuchen... ¡el reloj de la iglesia calle abajo está empezando a dar las doce!'
Escuchemos de nuevo toda la escena seguida.
How does my tie look today, Hannah? Zero orange juice in sight!
Sharp and spotless, Arthur! Even your glasses are on your nose instead of your forehead.
Progress! Today our courtyard hosts a family reunion. Quiet dignity from everyone!
Says the man peeking through the lace curtain every thirty seconds!
I am checking the weather, Tessa! Who left this thick envelope by the bell?
The mailman just asked me to sign for it. It has a red property office stamp.
From the building landlord's lawyer? Strange, our rent is paid until next summer.
Open it after twelve, boss! Look at the clock: five minutes to noon!
Right you are. Paperwork can wait. Put it beside the book for now.
I placed the blue suitcase right beside Caleb's table under the tree.
And the teapot is hot! Everybody step back from the window!
Listen... the church clock down the street is starting to chime twelve!
Ese sobre grueso con sello rojo queda sin abrir sobre el mostrador mientras las campanas de la iglesia empiezan a dar las doce. Salgamos a la verja en la próxima escena.
See you later!
